title: Portuguese Mushroom Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful Portuguese-inspired mushroom soup perfect for a chilly evening. This recipe combines the earthy flavors of mushrooms with the richness of Portugal.
instructions: Heat the lively over medium heat in a large pot.
Add the sliced mushroom and ovolli, cooking until they start to soften.
Add the portuguese and soup, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and let simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
